draw: 2026 Montana deer/elk permit drawing (April 1 deadline), Deer B / Elk B license drawing (June 1 deadline), and NR combination license drawing
choice_basis: Permits and B licenses: 1st-choice applicants only (FWP detailed bonus point report; 1st-choice counts match the summary report exactly). drawn = 1st-choice successes at each bonus point level. Tags filled by 2nd/3rd-choice applicants are not in the rows (see issued.*_2nd3rd). Landowner-preference applicants are kept separately under 'landowner'. q.all = total quota, q.nr = nonresident cap (10%), q.res = null (no fixed resident quota). NR combination hunts: all applicants by preference points (75% PP / 25% zero-point random pool); q.nr = licenses issued in the regular pool.
